fieldNotes.site: Flagship 1852 A-B brewery, world's largest single-site brewery. Sprawling fully-enclosed legacy urban industrial campus on the Mississippi River, bounded by I-55 to the west.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Multiple controlled truck gates confirmed in Street View - sliding/swing metal gates with chain-link/wall perimeter fencing throughout the campus (SV at SW corner off Pestalozzi, internal warehouse gate with yellow-marked swing gate, east trailer-yard gate). Whole campus is fenced/walled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A-B St. Louis has a long-documented staffed main entrance/guardhouse. Multiple gated checkpoints on a high-security legacy campus; guard presence is standard. High confidence on guarded entry though individual booth structures partly obscured by buildings in imagery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus comprises 40+ distinct brewery, packaging, warehouse and support buildings across multiple city blocks plus a large distribution warehouse.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of trailers parked across multiple large drop yards east of the distribution warehouse - estimated 400+ trailers visible, 600+ capacity.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ dock doors on the large white-roof distribution warehouse plus packaging-building docks; trailers backed in confirm active docks.
fieldNotes.railServed: Extensive on-site rail yards with many spurs running into the campus and warehouses; rail is heavily used at this site.
fieldNotes.scale: Truck scale presence inferred from heavy freight operation; not individually resolved in imagery - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Multi-gate campus with internal secondary gates between brewery core and warehouse/trailer-yard zones implies staged checkpoints; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Urban campus surrounded by public streets, I-55, and residential blocks; truck queues could spill onto city streets.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box covers the AB operational footprint (brewery core + distribution warehouse + trailer yards). ~254 acres for the boxed area; brewery proper is ~142 acres.

citations.claim: AB 2026 realignment closes/sells Fairfield, Merrimack, Newark; St. Louis explicitly unaffected and among facilities receiving investment.
Anheuser-Busch's St. Louis flagship brewery (1200 Lynch St) is the active home of Budweiser, running tours.

verification.rationale: Flagship St. Louis brewery; explicitly named unaffected by the 2026 closures and a recipient of investment.
